changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Revert combo table start_time and end_time columns from TIMESTAMPTZ to TIME for daily recurring times
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE combo ALTER COLUMN start_time TYPE TIME USING (start_time::TIME)
ALTER TABLE combo ALTER COLUMN end_time TYPE TIME USING (end_time::TIME)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE combo ALTER COLUMN start_time TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING (CURRENT_DATE + start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
ALTER TABLE combo ALTER COLUMN end_time TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING (CURRENT_DATE + end_time) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
